purpose: Quantify weekly dashboard signups by channel and device for prior week (2026-10-05 to 10-11) vs last week (2026-10-12 to
sql:
SELECT
  channel,
  device,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups,
  SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END)
  ) / NULLIF(
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END), 0
  ), 3) AS pct_change
FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
GROUP BY channel, device
ORDER BY channel, device

purpose: dashboard signups by week, device, channel for prior vs last week
sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'prior' WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 'last' END AS week,
  device,
  channel,
  SUM(signups) AS dashboard_signups
FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
WHERE signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

purpose: backend accounts by week, device, signup channel for prior vs last week
sql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 'prior' WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 'last' END AS week,
  device,
  signup_channel AS channel,
  COUNT(*) AS backend_accounts
FROM app_pg.accounts
WHERE to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

purpose: weekly ad spend, clicks, and impressions change prior vs last week
sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS prior_spend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN spend_usd ELSE 0 END) AS last_spend,
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS prior_clicks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END) AS last_clicks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN impressions ELSE 0 END) AS prior_impressions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN impressions ELSE 0 END) AS last_impressions
  FROM ads_pg.ad_spend_daily
)
SELECT
  prior_spend, last_spend, last_spend - prior_spend AS spend_change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_spend - prior_spend) / NULLIF(prior_spend, 0), 3) AS spend_pct_change,
  prior_clicks, last_clicks, last_clicks - prior_clicks AS clicks_change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_clicks - prior_clicks) / NULLIF(prior_clicks, 0), 3) AS clicks_pct_change,
  prior_impressions, last_impressions, last_impressions - prior_impressions AS impressions_change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_impressions - prior_impressions) / NULLIF(prior_impressions, 0), 3) AS impressions_pct_change
FROM weekly

purpose: paid vs non-paid dashboard signup split prior vs last week
sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN channel IN ('paid_search','paid_social','display') THEN 'paid' ELSE 'non_paid' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS prior_signups,
    SUM(CASE WHEN signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN signups ELSE 0 END) AS last_signups
  FROM app_pg.trial_signups_daily
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  channel_group,
  prior_signups, last_signups,
  last_signups - prior_signups AS change,
  ROUND(100.0 * (last_signups - prior_signups) / NULLIF(prior_signups, 0), 3) AS pct_change
FROM weekly
ORDER BY channel_group

purpose: ad platform change log during Oct 5-18
sql:
SELECT
  changed_at, campaign_id, change_type, old_value, new_value, changed_by
FROM ads_pg.ad_change_log
WHERE to_date(changed_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY changed_at

SELECT effective_date, plan, monthly_price_usd
FROM app_pg.pricing_history
WHERE effective_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY effective_date, plan

SELECT holiday_date, holiday_name, is_federal
FROM whybot.ca_holidays
WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
ORDER BY holiday_date

purpose: backend trial accounts by channel prior vs last week
sql:
SELECT
  signup_channel AS channel,
  SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  - SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS change
FROM app_pg.accounts
WHERE to_date(created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-05' AND DATE '2026-10-18'
GROUP BY signup_channel
ORDER BY channel
